# Adler & Rochefort

> Adler & Rochefort is the trading name of Ownizo, Unipessoal Lda., an insurance intermediary registered with Portugal's insurance supervisor (ASF, no. 425591790/3), with offices in Lisbon and Lagos (Algarve). It advises private clients, expatriates and international families on health, high-value home, collections, liability and family protection insurance in Portugal and Spain, and arranges international health insurance (IPMI) with Allianz Care and Cigna Global for expatriates living anywhere in the world. Advice is given in writing, in English, Spanish, German and Portuguese. Founder: Hugo Gonçalves.

Key facts for international health insurance (IPMI):

- Insurers placed: Allianz Care and Cigna Global, compared side by side on the same terms.
- US citizens living outside the United States are placed with Cigna Global; Allianz Care does not accept US citizens.
- International plans are for people living outside their country of nationality; the policy is based on the main country of residence (where the client spends most of the year).
- To quote, only four details are needed: full name, date of birth, nationality and the country where the client will live (plus the US state for US nationals).
- No fee to the client: the broker is paid by the insurer. Written reply within one working day.
- Contact: insurance@adlerrochefort.com · +351 928 226 570

## International health insurance (worldwide)

- [International health insurance for expats](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/international-health-insurance/): what IPMI is, Allianz Care vs Cigna Global, eligibility rules, real anonymised quotes and the quote form.
- [Seguro médico internacional para expatriados](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-medico-internacional/): Spanish version, written for Spanish speakers and Latin Americans moving to any country.
- [Internationale Krankenversicherung](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/internationale-krankenversicherung/): German version, for German emigrants and expats.
- [US citizens living abroad](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/international-health-insurance/us-citizens-abroad/): Cigna Global, Medicare abroad, US cover options.
- [Expats in Thailand](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/international-health-insurance/thailand/): international cover and the O-A retirement visa insurance requirement.
- [Expats in Mexico](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/international-health-insurance/mexico/): Americans, Canadians and Europeans living in Mexico.
- [Expats in the Philippines](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/international-health-insurance/philippines/): professionals, families and retirees.
- [Digital nomads and remote workers](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/international-health-insurance/digital-nomads/): annual cover versus travel insurance, nomad visas.
- [Retirees living abroad](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/international-health-insurance/retirees-abroad/): premiums at 64, pre-existing conditions, retirement visas.
- [Latinoamericanos que se mudan a España](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-medico-internacional/espana/): seguro y requisitos de visado en España.
- [Nómadas digitales](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-medico-internacional/nomadas-digitales/)
- [Mexicanos en el extranjero](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-medico-internacional/mexicanos-en-el-extranjero/)
- [Auswandern nach Thailand](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/internationale-krankenversicherung/thailand/)
- [Rentner im Ausland](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/internationale-krankenversicherung/rentner-im-ausland/)
- [Digitale Nomaden](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/internationale-krankenversicherung/digitale-nomaden/)
- [Allianz Care vs Cigna Global](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/blog/allianz-care-vs-cigna-global-portugal-spain/): detailed comparison of plan levels, modules, maternity, US cover and underwriting.
